name: Wireless Compromise
summary: Adversaries may perform wireless compromise as a method of gaining communications and unauthorized access to a wireless network. Access to a wireless network may be gained through the compromise of a wireless device. Adversaries may also utilize radios and other wireless communication devices on the same frequency as the wireless network. analytics.name: Analytic 1859
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a previously unseen wireless device identity joining or authenticating to an ICS wireless segment—such as Wi-Fi/802.1X, WirelessHART, ISA100.11a, or a vendor radio mesh—when its MAC/EUI, certificate, or device identifier is absent from the approved wireless asset inventory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

analytics.name: Analytic 2124
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a process executing iwconfig or ip link set promisc, or loading mac80211 monitor mode, on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset outside normal configuration management activity. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
